items.title: Vita Vea: Makes trade request
items.body_text: Vea and his representation have requested a trade from the Buccaneers, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Brooks: Placed on NFI list
items.body_text: The Packers have placed Brooks (undisclosed) on the active/non-football injury list ahead of training camp, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: Opens camp on PUP list
items.body_text: The Colts placed Pierce (ankle) on the active/PUP list Monday, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tucker Kraft: Lands on PUP list
items.body_text: The Packers have placed Kraft (ACL) on the active/PUP list Monday ahead of training camp, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: George Holani: Alternating with first team
items.body_text: Holani and rookie first-round pick Jadarian Price have split first-team reps during the early days of training camp, Gregg Bell of The News Tribune reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
